HDMI | USB | HDCP 2.3 | EDID | 2-way PoH | Bidirectional RS-232 | CEC

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Introducing the RX3-100, an uncompressed 18G HDBaseT 3.0 receiver that achieves signal transmission up to 100m/328ft at 4K@60Hz via Cat.6A cable. With HDBaseT 3.0, experience USB data transfers of up to 300Mbps, nearly doubling HDBaseT 2.0's capability of 190Mbps. This heightened capacity supports high-speed connections to 4K webcams, whiteboards, and data drives. The RX3-100 seamlessly pairs with any of WyreStorm's HDBaseT 3.0 transmitter options, such as the SW-120-TX3 and SW-120-TX3-Ux for a powerful switching extender solution!

The main feature of the RX3-100 is the 3 device ports, which are capable of USB 2.0 pass-through, which offers not only KVM functionality for extension of a keyboard/mouse or touchscreen, but also full data transfer capabilities of 300Mbps for 4K UHD webcams and high-speed data drives.

The RX-100 boasts bidirectional PoH, which can power or be powered by a transmitters such as the SW-120-TX3-Ux or SW-120-TX3, while also passing bidirectional RS-232 control to either the display or back to the head-end. If RS-232 isn’t an option, it also supports CEC signals from the transmitter

Compatible with mainstream audio DSPs and video bars, including brands such as Q-SYS, Shure, Biamp, Extron, Yealink, Logitech and more. For details, please refer to the USB compatibility list
Supports independent lane analog audio pass-through from transmitter to receiver
Backwards compatible with HDBaseT 1.0 transmission and receiving devices (lowest denominator takes priority)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
